name: query
label: Query
help: Partial, case-insensitive match on domain or name.

name: label
label: Label
help: Only sites that carry this exact label.

name: sort
label: Sort
help: position (your saved order, default), name (A to Z) or visitors (unique visitors in the last 30 days, most first). Starred sites always come first.

name: limit
label: Limit
help: The maximum number of results Make returns during one execution cycle.
